name: Iliac Crest Apophysitis
definition: Overuse traction injury of the iliac-crest apophysis in adolescent athletes caused by repetitive pull of abdominal and hip muscles.

typical: Pain with running or trunk motion

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; radiographs or MRI are used when avulsion or atypical pathology is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent focal pain needs reassessment for avulsion or other pelvic pathology.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni/Asthi growth-related phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Overuse traction injury of the iliac-crest apophysis in adolescent athletes caused by repetitive pull of abdominal and hip muscles.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
